changelogEntries.message: fix(updater): share manager state, serialize checks, and fix cache match
changelogEntries.body:
Share AppContainer.updateManager in SettingsViewModel so background
checks and downloads stay in sync with Settings, allow manual re-checks
when an older update state is cached, serialize checkForUpdates without
clobbering active downloads, disable HTTP cache and surface failure
details in fetchUrlStringDetailed, and match split-APK version codes.

changelogEntries.message: feat(conversation): add chat wallpaper sync and WAProto message features
changelogEntries.body:
Wire 9:16 portrait chat wallpaper upload, blur/rotation/doodle-opacity
adjustments, and theme sync alongside limit-sharing, after-read
ephemeral duration, keep-in-chat, scheduled messages, draft sync, and
quiz/poll option additions.

changelogEntries.message: feat(groups): support adding bot JIDs and check participant status
changelogEntries.body:
Preserve full JIDs such as 867051314767696@bot in AddParticipantDialog
with a one-tap Meta AI chip, format @bot JIDs cleanly in ContactHelper,
and report non-200 participant update statuses in GroupInfoViewModel.

changelogEntries.message: chore(ui): remove redundant null checks and casts
changelogEntries.body:
Clean up unnecessary safe calls, redundant toInt() conversions, and
non-null assertions in GroupInfoScreen and ChannelFeedScreen.

changelogEntries.message: fix(sticker): preserve full audio track when trimming video stickers
changelogEntries.body:
Extract the full M4A audio track (with raw file fallback) instead of
truncating at the sticker trim length, and guard against empty muxer
outputs.

changelogEntries.message: feat(stickers): auto-split packs over 30 and add quick-send ux
changelogEntries.body:
Split sticker packs exceeding WhatsApp's 30-sticker limit into numbered
30-sticker chunks when sending, and allow one-tap sending of imported
packs from section headers, the pack drawer, and the pack send dialog.

changelogEntries.message: feat(settings,protocol): add protocol types inspector and visibility toggle
changelogEntries.body:
Add a Protocol Types screen in Advanced Settings to inspect WAProto
messages, enums, custom builders, and schema definitions, along with a
toggle to display hidden protocol messages as timeline pills in chats.

changelogEntries.message: refactor(home): remove phone-masking eye button from top bar
changelogEntries.body:
Keep phone-number masking exclusively in Privacy Settings so the Home
app bar stays uncluttered.

changelogEntries.message: fix(newsletter): dismiss emoji sheet on composer focus
changelogEntries.body:
Close the emoji and sticker sheet when the channel post input gains
focus instead of relying on a clickable modifier that the text field
consumed.
